snippet.description:
Learn polar curve tracing solved examples step by step for B.Sc. Maths and calculus exams. Master polar coordinates, symmetry, pole tangents, and asymptotes.

Is video me hum Polar Curve Tracing ke standard and important solved examples ko step-by-step detail me solve karenge. Agar aapko polar equations ka behavior analyze karne me problem aati hai, to yeh lecture aapke liye best guide hai!

Hum cover karenge:

Symmetry Test: Initial line ($ \theta = 0 $), pole, and line $ \theta = \pi/2 $ ke across symmetry check karna.
Pole & Tangents at Pole: $ r = 0 $ put karke polar tangents find karna aur curve origin se kaise pass hota hai samajhna.
Region / Angular Variation: Values of $ r $ for different values of $ \theta $ calculate karna.
Asymptotes & Curve Sketching: Infinite aur finite curves ko accurately trace karne ka systematic tareeqa.

00:00 - Introduction & Recap of Polar Tracing Rules
03:19 - Example 1: Tracing Cardioid r = a(1 + cos θ)
04:30 - Cardioid: Symmetry Check
05:20 - Cardioid: Pole & Tangent at the Pole
07:11 - Cardioid: Asymptote Analysis
09:35 - Cardioid: Table of Values & Range of r
12:35 - Cardioid: Sketching the Curve
16:02 - Cardioid: Plotting on Desmos
17:03 - Example 2: Tracing 3-Leaved Rose r = a sin(3θ)
17:34 - 3-Leaved Rose: Symmetry Analysis
19:57 - 3-Leaved Rose: Pole & Tangents at the Pole
22:23 - 3-Leaved Rose: Region of Existence & Table of Values
27:23 - 3-Leaved Rose: Number of Loops (n vs 2n rule)
28:18 - 3-Leaved Rose: Sketching the Curve
30:46 - 3-Leaved Rose: Plotting on Desmos
31:43 - Example 3: Tracing Equiangular Spiral r = a e^(mθ)
32:23 - Equiangular Spiral: Symmetry & Pole Behavior
34:30 - Equiangular Spiral: Asymptotes & Region
37:03 - Equiangular Spiral: Behavior as θ Increases & Decreases
38:26 - Equiangular Spiral: Sketching the Spiral
39:26 - Equiangular Spiral: Desmos Dynamic Animation
40:42 - Summary & Next Topic Preview (Envelopes)

🔸B.Sc, B.Sc B.Ed, Maths students 
🔸B.Tech Engineering Maths

👉 https://amzn.to/4cRttb2

📘 Integral Calculus – Shanti Narayan & P.K. Mittal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cReFsT

📘 Calculus, Vol. 1: One-Variable Calculus, with an Introduction to Linear Algebra – Tom M. Apostol
👉 https://amzn.to/4mBuoQ9

📘Higher Engineering Mathematics — B.S. Grewal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cz7dS7

📘Advanced Engineering Mathematics — Erwin Kreyszig
👉 https://amzn.to/41FY1pW

👉 https://amzn.to/42cW0Sf

📘 Schaum’s Outline of Calculus

Happy Learning! 📐✨
